user.title: Samsung SmartTags Setup
user.description:
Visit [SmartThings Find]({url}) and sign in with your Samsung account.

1. Open your browser Developer Tools (F12).
2. Open the Application/Storage tab.
3. Find the cookies for `smartthingsfind.samsung.com`.
4. Copy the value of the **JSESSIONID** cookie.

The JSESSIONID is a sensitive session credential. Do not share it or post it in logs/issues.

init.title: Update SmartThings Find connection
init.description:
Update the Samsung session or region used by the integration. To get a new JSESSIONID, visit [SmartThings Find]({url}), sign in, then copy the JSESSIONID cookie from your browser Developer Tools.

Treat this value like a password and do not share it.
